question:
On the basis of Total Population (2011), arrange the following states in descending order?

A) West Bengal

B) Maharashtra

C) Bihar
solution:
The correct answer is __**B, C, A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Maharashtra** has the highest population among the given states with a population of approximately 112 million as per the 2011 Census.
 
• **Bihar** is the second most populous state among the given states with a population of around 104 million according to the 2011 Census.
 
• **West Bengal** ranks third among the given states with a total population of approximately 91 million as per the 2011 Census.
 
• The population rankings are based on the Census data of 2011, which is the most recent comprehensive demographic data available.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Census of India** is conducted every 10 years and provides comprehensive demographic data for all states and Union Territories.
 
• **Maharashtra** is located in the western region of India and is the second-most populous state in the country.
 
• **Bihar** is located in the eastern part of India and is known for its large population density.
 
• **West Bengal** is located in the eastern region of India and is known for its rich cultural heritage and high population density.
 
• The Census data is crucial for planning and implementation of various government policies and programs aimed at population management and resource allocation.
